title: Secret Hitler XL
sub: 6 to 19 players. The fan expansion by Bo-Jivan Parker (Lord_Roguy): a Communist party, thirteen extra roles, emergency powers and anti-policies. Use Part One for everything not changed here.

html: XL is a kit of modules. Every part is optional, and the table shows when each one is worth adding.

rows: A third hidden party with its own board, policies and powers.
Always. This is what makes XL.
Ten one-shot policies that give the President an extra power.
Thirteen roles with their own powers and goals.
Policies that remove a rival policy and help the Liberals.

html: Each envelope holds three cards, plus the Ja! and Nein ballot cards. The Secret Role card says who you are. The Role Briefing card explains, on its own, how that role wins, what it knows and what it can do. The Party Membership card is what investigations see.

caption: A Communist's envelope: Secret Role, Role Briefing, Party Membership, and the two ballot cards.
Counts for 6 to 16 players are from the XL rules. 17 to 19 players are experimental. Those counts are a suggestion of this edition, not part of the XL rules.

items: Fascist board: by player count, as in the original game: 5-6, 7-8 or 9+ players.
Communist board: one board for every player count.
Who knows whom: the Communists always know each other. Hitler knows the Fascists only when there is exactly one Fascist.

rows: Spare membership deck: 2 Liberal, 1 Fascist, 1 Communist
The Detective, if that role plays

html: Read it aloud at setup. Lines marked with a role are read only when that role is in the game. Fascists here means the Fascist roles, the Bodyguard, the Fascist Spy, and a Propagandist, Bureaucrat or Detective holding a Fascist card: never Hitler, the Monarchist or the Jester.

title: Night script for Secret Hitler XL
lines: Everybody close your eyes and hold a fist out in front of you.
Only with the Detective: Detective, open your eyes. Take the top card of the spare membership deck: you now belong to that party. Put it in your envelope and close your eyes.
Fascists, except Hitler and the Monarchist, open your eyes and recognise each other.
Hitler, put your thumb out. Fascists, this is Hitler. Hitler, put your thumb away. (With only one Fascist, Hitler opens their eyes with them instead.)
Only with the Monarchist: Monarchist, put your thumb out. Fascists, this is the Monarchist. Monarchist, put your thumb away.
Only with the Spies: Liberal Spy, open your eyes. Fascists, put your thumbs out. Thumbs away. Liberal Spy, close your eyes.
Communists, open your eyes and recognise each other.
Only with the Anarchist: Anarchist, put your thumb out (with only one other Communist, open your eyes instead). Thumb away.
Only with Centrists: Centrists, open your eyes, recognise each other, close your eyes.
Everybody put your hands down and open your eyes.

label: How long is a big game?
html: The Communist board adds up to five more governments. From 11 players, emergency tiles stretch the game further, so that most players get a turn as President.
